entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support publishing file-based apps #49189
  • Have an Option to Create a .slnx For `dotnet project convert` #49187
  • Support file-based apps with `dotnet watch` #49185
  • Set environment variables containing the entry-point file path and directory when running file-based apps #49184
  • Move `ImplicitUsings` and `Nullable` into the core targets #49182
  • Unable to build project using VS 17.14 “DiscoverPrecompressedAssets” task failed unexpectedly #49180
  • `dotnet project convert` works incorrectly for target framework other than default base framework `net10.0` #49177

Closed

  • `dotnet list package` invalid TFM resolution #49179
  • `dotnet run file.cs` doesn't work with Aspire SDK #49165

PullRequests

Created

  • Exclude upstream files from Emscripten and code coverage #49186
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [Blazor] Disable custom cache in .NET 10 #49183
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • reduce the need of customizing Help output #49181
    Area-CLI
  • [StaticWebAsset] Exclude source maps from updating fingerprinted blazor.js #49178
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • [release/9.0.3xx] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49174
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49173
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/8.0.4xx] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49172
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/8.0.3xx] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49171
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/8.0.1xx] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49170
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview5] Fix minimum width of Author column in tabular output #49169

Merged

  • Fix API Diff args + async #49164
    Area-ApiCompat
  • Build & run tests for test templates via a pipeline to support CG #49147
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • Update maintenance-packages pruning versions #49092
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49125
  • File watcher: ignore directories, allow watching non-recursively #49150
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Adjust `IsTestProject` hacks to not include MTP #49085
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49080
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
  • Support launchSettings.json workingDirectory with dotnet run #42534
    untriaged, Area-CLI
  • Enable container tests #48910
  • [WiX 5] Migrate SDK from v3 to v5 #48699
